name: Can I install grab bars myself, or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I install grab bars myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it's possible to install grab bars as a DIY project, hiring a professional general contractor like City Dweller, LLC is highly recommended. Professionals ensure proper placement for optimal support, secure mounting into studs or appropriate anchors, and adherence to safety standards. Incorrect installation can lead to grab bars failing, causing serious injury. We have the right tools and expertise to guarantee a safe and durable installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hiring a professional for grab bar installation is recommended over DIY to ensure proper, safe mounting into studs or correct anchors, preventing potential failure and injury.
